name: Sunday Robotics Memo
description: A wheeled, soft-shelled domestic robot from Sunday Robotics — dual arms on a mobile base rather than a bipedal build, trained from home-collected human demonstrations captured with the company's wearable Skill Capture Glove rather than teleoperation.

sourcing: Specs, training method, and pricing sourced from Sunday Robotics' own site (sunday.ai) as of September 2026. This is a pre-launch product: no unit has shipped, no consumer price is set, and the manufacturing cost, task list, and timeline above are the company's own claims rather than independently reviewed or third-party tested figures. Filed here under Humanoid & General Purpose · Other since it's a general-purpose domestic manipulation robot on a wheeled base rather than a bipedal humanoid, which doesn't fit this category's existing Two Legs / Four Legs subcategories. robotindex does not sell this product.

pricing.summary: Not yet for sale, with no consumer retail price announced. Sunday Robotics states each hand-built unit currently costs roughly $20,000 to manufacture and expects volume production to cut that by more than half.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: Memo is a dual-arm manipulator on a wheeled base, wrapped in a soft silicone shell for compliant control — it can be pushed aside mid-task and stays upright if powered off. Arms extend to ~7 feet (typically ~4 feet), with movement capped at half human speed. Training uses a wearable "Skill Capture Glove" worn by home-based "Memory Developers," not teleoperation.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: Unlike approaches that rely on teleoperation or lab-based rigs, Memo is trained via a wearable "Skill Capture Glove" that a network of at-home demonstrators wear to record everyday hand movements, extracted directly into the robot's onboard AI. As a pre-launch product, its ~$20,000-per-unit manufacturing cost and demonstrated task list are Sunday Robotics' own claims, not yet independently verified.

firmwareCommunity.note: Sunday Robotics Memo has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
